product_name: Hello FAB Coconut Skin Smoothie Priming Moisturizer
review_text: Makes my skin feel hydrated and soft. It has a tint of color in it but I think it gives my skin a nice glow. It also does not give me pimples.

I have never in my life written a review for anything but this deserves it. I have dry to combo skin and usually decently clear skin. The last few months my skin has been TRIPPIN but since I’ve used this I haven’t had a single breakout. The only downside I’ve noticed is that my skin is slightly rougher than normal, not blaming the cleanser necessarily, who knows. I’ve just been exfoliating a little more than average and I’m solid. Anyways just buy this, do yourself the favor.

Disappointed i really wanted to love this! Multiple beauty bloggers who i love ranted & raved over this product. Let’s start off with the packing.. it’s cheap and not super luxe. A little does go a long way which is why i gave it an additional star so you many get a good bang for your buck if this product floats your boat. I have combination skin, which i rarely ever break out. I tried this for 3 days- when you first apply it sorta smells like a light hint of mint but dies off quickly. It dries quickly.. After use of this i couldn’t help to notice i had small little bumps on my forehead.. i gave it the benefit of the doubt and continued two more days of use. I wore it over night and yes i woke up dewy by also won’t up to two massage pimples on my forehead.  Needless to i won’t be using this any more, i don’t break out and this moisturizer won’t stay in my beauty Arsenal in that case.

product_name: High-Potency Night-a-Mins Resurfacing Cream with Fruit-Derived AHAs
review_text: Amazing night cream! Rich and creamy and leaves skin feeling so moisturized and refreshed!

product_name: Auto Correct Brightening + Depuffing Eye Cream for Dark Circles
review_text: I love this eye cream. It says that you can use it morning and night, but I found it better to use in the morning with the ingredients in it. It really helps me look “more alert“. Ideally, I would like to have an eye cream that I can use morning and night, but I am ok with having two different eye creams. It really helps depuff my eyes!

product_name: Green Clean Makeup Meltaway Cleansing Balm Limited Edition Jumbo
review_text: I’m on my second jar and I’m so in love with this makeup remover. It says to use a generous amount but personally, I use a dime size amount. A lot goes a long way! I use this on my face and neck right before I take my shower than I rinse if all off. After I use my normal face wash.  This has never caused me any breakouts.

I’ve seen all sorts of people/influencers use this product on social media and it’s quite frustrating and misleading when it’s used incorrectly.First, I don’t lather my face with this. LESS IS MORE. Second -I won’t use this more than once or twice per 1 &1/2-2 weeks and I will space out the usage. (i.e. chemical exfoliant pm on a monday night then use this product on a wednesday or thursday -no retinol and/or other exfoliants in between those days)If you use this often, then you’re going to legit burn your skin. The smell is quite interesting, almost smells like a very concentrated citrus smell (I have a strong sense of smell). I’m only able to keep this on my skin for about 6-7 minutes bc I can’t stand my face feeling too dry. After use, I’m left with baby soft skin. In the morning my skin looks so nice! The following morning I find that I’m more conscious of reapplying sunscreen.

It works fine with breaking up sunscreens and face make up, but it’s not as effective with waterproof eye makeup like mascara. It takes quite a while to break that up, and it does sensitize my eyes after. When it used it a couple times, I had the formula separate on me (came out half oil half balm), but it still worked it was just odd. I’m not sure if other people noticed the little oat kernels in the formula, but that stuff got in my eye and it was definitely really uncomfortable. Overall, it does the job at a low price, so I can’t get too mad at it.

This had a minimizing pore effect after only one use. It’s lightweight and I use it under my moisturizer at night without issue. I seem to be in the minority but I don’t like the scent, however it doesn’t last long so it’s fine. I really look forward to seeing what it does with continued use after seeing it work so well after just a few days. The stubborn bumps I had also seem flatter now!
I have comb skin, before i use this cream, i can rarely see my pores around my nose. But after i used it, it makes my pores look much bigger. Then i stoped using it, just use it as a neck cream.

This is probably better for people with oily skin. I have combination skin and felt that it didn’t give me the type of moisture that I was looking for. Prefer Lala out of the options for moisturizers.
Works amazing! Will purchase again. Got all dead skin off my face feels very smooth after applying. My skin.

product_name: Power Couple Advanced Retinol and Lactic Acid Duo
review_text: I got this kit as a way to try the brand out and work on my clogged pores. I use both at night and my boyfriend uses just the Luna oil. Well somehow I have an almost full bottle of oil and the good genes is completely gone. And I always use a lot of oil.  DECEPTIVE. I like the oil, will continue to use but I no longer really want to deal with Sunday Riley. It’s just non functional.
good wipes didn’t leave my face all red after and took off makeup well

I honestly love this product SO much. I never had acne/bad skin when growing up, But, I had a bad allergic reaction to Penicillin for a throat infection and after that? My skin changed 100%...I had a lot of breakouts, texture issues, and closed comedones for years. After spending years and a small fortune on different skincare regimes, this product paired w/ the 10% lactic acid? They’ve completely turned my skin back around and on it’s way back to its og state. Seriously, within two weeks? My entire jaw/chin was smooth for the first time in years. This has helped to improve my confidence SO much. The fact that the pricing is so great, that’s just the cherry on top. If you have any textural issues or acne (whether sporadic breakouts or bad hormonal cystic spots) this will save your skin!!!

I have photo-contact dermatitis and most sunscreens cause my face to break out in an itchy, burning rash. I am only able to use physical sunscreens but many of these leave a hazy white film on my brown skin. I have used Supergoop for sensitive skin in the past and even that one caused some mild itching but this one it PERFECT. It is clear, not sticky and goes on like a make up primer. And most importantly, I have worn it for the past few weeks without absolutely no reaction whatsoever. A little goes along way and it is worth every penny. Please Supergoop, don’t ever discontinue or change this product!

I was really excited to purchase this product after reading excellent reviews all over the place. However, using this underneath my water-based foundation made it TOTALLY streak. I have tried letting it dry, but I find that this silicone based sunscreen leaves me with a slippery base for my makeup slippery instead of becoming tacky like my go to, Too Faced hangover Rx primer. I’m disappointed and will continue my serach for a daily sunscreen to wear under my makeup.

product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
review_text: I purchased this product several times before and added it to my loved items. Last month, I purchased 2 new containers. At home I discovered that both are old and EXTREMELY SMELLY. I know this product well, so I know that this is not its smell nor should it be the smell of any product you would put on your body or face. VERY DISAPPOINTED!

Sometimes during the year, typically mid summer and mid winter, my face feels really dry and irritated. For the past few weeks ive been using this product. I would recommend anytime, does what it says on the box. Results after 24hrs, but you can see the difference after one single use. Depending of my schedule i use it, max, twice a day.

product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
review_text: I have sensitive acne prone skin and it broke me out after 2 uses. Makes my skin look really greasy and oily.

product_name: T.L.C. Framboos Glycolic Resurfacing Night Serum
review_text: Dude idk what they put in here that makes it magic but I am normally an acne Petri dish right before my time of the month and after only one week of use this serum kept hormonal acne at bay?!?!?! I’m STUNNED. My oral antibiotic isn’t even this good at clearing my face.

very hydrating, easy to apply and comes with its applicator, I really liked that!  the packaging is beautiful it looks like a pearl!  I love!  but above all something that is important to me is that I hydrated enough

product_name: Find Your Balance Oil Control Cleanser
review_text: Oily Skin Heaven. I got this from influenster and I fell in love with how it leave my skin brighter and oil free.

I have combination/acne-prone skin. I found this cleanser to be a little below average considering the price. I really wanted to love this but it didn’t seem to really clean out my pores. Since I have started using this about a month  ago my skin has been breaking out non-stop around the cheeks and jawline. I am wondering if I am allergic to something in it. But I will not directly blame this product for my breakout as it could be caused by diet or stress. I just had hopes that it would help keep my skin clear, but I guess I should be looking in the acne-prone range of cleansers. Pros to the product are that it isn’t drying and has a decent scent, if you don’t mind cucumber.

product_name: The Rice Polish Foaming Enzyme Powder
review_text: One of the best skin care products out there!! so happy sephora jump in to the tatcha van wagoon. Can’t wait till they sell the whole line!!

product_name: Yo Glow AHA & BHA Facial Enzyme Scrub
review_text: A nice exfoliant. The scrub gives the impression of dead skin coming off, but it’s mostly the scrub itself. I use a light facewash to wash off the remains after I’m finished. Doesn’t seem to cause acne flare ups.

product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
review_text: I love how it makes my skin feel hydrated, soft and primed. My skin looks more matte after putting it on. However, I’m not a fan of how it dries so fast and you can’t really blend it in more. I used it as a primer before putting on my makeup. Looking forward to seeing how it keeps my makeup on all day I received this product for testing purposes.

product_name: Lip Sleeping Mask Intense Hydration with Vitamin C
review_text: Don’t know how this product is rated so highly. My lips do not feel rejuvenated at all when I wake up in the morning. If anything it feels drier. Not worth the hype!!

After consistent use I can say I wouldn’t recommend this. I saw almost no improvement. At best, it semi helped with some dry skin under my eyes. It also felt a bit greasy so when I rubbed my eyes later in the night it burned a little in my eyes. I received this for free in exchange for my honest opinion from Influenster.

I received a sample of this facial cleanser along with my Clarisonic, so I decided to give it a shot. After using it the first time I LOVED the results. Such a squeaky clean feel, and I could almost see instant results. I wouldn’t say I have problematic skin but often get plugged pored and occasional break outs. I had a break out at the time I used this and it cleared it up. UNFORTUNATELY, after 3 uses.. My skin was embarrassingly red and flaking, even caused the same effects on my lips! I quickly switched and my skin was burning and flaking for 4 days!! So bummed my skin reacted this way because it cleared up my skin so well.. I suppose it just wasn’t for my skin..

product_name: Magic Cream Moisturizer with Hyaluronic Acid
review_text: I have oily skin with some sensitivities, this cream intensely nourishes and protects my skin barrier, it’s so rich!!! I barely have to touch the cream and the product on my fingers is enough for my oily face. I love how my makeup applies after I use this on my face. This is amazing and I wish I’d bought it earlier to use in the extreme cold weather this winter! If you have dry skin, or skin that’s healing from trauma, I highly recommend this!

I enjoy the way this seems to sooth my skin and create a nice layer of moisture after using my toner, but I don’t necessarily know if I see a huge difference in using the product. Because of its price point and the way it cools my skin, I do enjoy it and will likely continue to use it long-term to see if I notice any changes down the road. My skin is often red and irritated, and this seems to reduce that slightly immediately after use. That is only main impact I have physically seen since starting to use it.

Very nice for my dry skin! Not sure if I would repurchase, I use this almost like a moisturizer at night and works very well, but it’s very expensive and I think there’s a ton of more budget-friendly options that are just as good!
If I could give this zero stars I would THIS IS NOT FOR SENSITIVE SKIN USERSThe second I did a spot test IT BURNED SO BAD I’m returning it ASAP.
These wipes are everything I need! One side that exfoliates and the other to take my makeup off, while making my face clear and clean! Smells fab too ;)
I don’t understand all the good reviews. This has fragrance very high in the ingredient list which should be a concern for everyone. Would not recommend or ever use again.

I received Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Cream free for review purposes from Influenster. I was very interested in this product because of the following benefits: salicylic acid, hyaluronic acid, vegan and cruelty free I have dry skin, fine lines and texture  with hormonal acne (made worse by constant masking). I loved the smooth texture of the formula and that it was not harsh on my skin. I did not experience any redness or dryness after use. My skin actually looked plumper and had a healthy glow without any reflective particles. The product does not have a strong scent and the cream itself is a firm texture that blends out evenly. Perfect barrier for dry and cold winter months
Love!!! Great smell! I love how easy my mascara comes off. One side is smooth , other is ruff for  exfoliating .

I love all things Inkey but this was not good. Greasy awful mess! It smelled odd, and I thought the liquid rested at the bottom, so I shook it and squeezed again, nope.  This is not a balm like Farmacy or Eve Lom but a greasy gross mess.  Pass.
Just ok. Not sure I would repurchase. I notice more of an even skin tone but don’t think it does much for blemishes or oil control in my opinion

Love this product! I have sensitive skin and this has helped clear me acne when very few products worked. I saw results after a little as two days. This brand has become a staple in my skin routine after this!

product_name: Mini Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme Moisturizer
review_text: I received a sample of Estée Lauder’s new Revitalizing Supreme+ Youth Power Creme free to try for my honest opinion. I love it! It is a bit thicker than some other products I have used so it takes a little more. It has a very nice scent to it. It is very hydrating to my dry skin so that is a huge plus! You can feel the instant hydration as soon as it is applied. It doesn’t leave my skin feeling ‘greasy’ after use either. I noticed a ‘glow’ to my face after applying as well. By the time I finished the sample size bottle I started noticing firmer skin on my face which is nice. I will definitely be purchasing a full size bottle to continue use & I do recommend!

product_name: Mini Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
review_text: I had been using the same face soap for over 4 years because I was too scared to change up. I have extremely sensitive acne prone skin (I’m on prescription medication for my acne). My acne was manageable but still very much still there. I had texture on my forehead and chin and I would constantly have at least one, two or even more pimples. I finally decided I needed to switch it up. I did research and Tatcha was advertised as a safe, good for sensitive skin, easy and sadly expensive option. I decided it was worth the money. I have been using this cleanser along with the cleaning oil and water cream moisturizer for two months now. AND I LOVE IT. It changed the texture of my face. I still have breakouts but not nearly as much or bad. Plus I feel good about the stuff I’m putting on my face. It definitely has changed my whole perspective on skin care!

product_name: Mini The Essence  Skincare Boosting Treatment
review_text: I am not been a huge softener fan, nor have I understood its effects. However... since I started using this product 3 DAYS ago, I have seen a noticeable difference in my skin. I struggle with redness and uneven skin tone. My skin type is oily/combo, so I can also struggle with balancing hydrating and shine. In combo with the dewy cream, my skin has looked even more clear (even when I didn’t struggle with blemishes before so I didn’t know this was possible), bright, and most importantly - even skin tone. I definitely think this product and the dewy cream have helped reduce my redness. My skin has been looking soooo good lately, and it has only been 3 days. I am a total fan of THIS softener now, and I understand the impact of using a softener. Applying this product with a cotton pad felt sooooo good too. It feels like a clean, hydrating, fresh swipe on my face. I have tried a lot of toners/liquid exfoliators and my skin often feels bone dry and uncomfortable after. My skin feels refreshed after using this softener. I highly highly highly recommend.

product_name: Ultimate Sun Protector Lotion SPF 50+ Sunscreen
review_text: Strongly fragranced stings eyes. Can’t use on my face. Also felt very slick and greasy. Would not recommend.

product_name: Drink Up Intensive Overnight Hydrating Mask with Avocado & Swiss Glacier Water
review_text: This is truly INCREDIBLE, if not for the fact that it breaks me out in whiteheads within hours. But that’s by my own skins fault, this product is a MUST HAVE for dry skin! I’m seasonally dry as a drought (as I am at the moment) Amazing results besides the fact, so -1 star from me. But that doesn’t seem so fair since it’s my own skins reaction to it, either way I must return it!
Too heavy and sticky for my liking.

This is an incredible product that gives over night results but even better with prolonged use. It doesn’t have a taste or smell and feels like a silky lip balm. I have to wear a mark at work all day which ends up with my lips being super dry and this helped me battle the chapped itchy feeling. I sometimes use it before work under my mask because it stays well and also keeps them hydrated through my shifts. I know this is going to be great for the winter!

product_name: Mini Abeille Royale Advanced Youth Watery Oil
review_text: Ok firstly, I love the bottle. It looks so fancy, and I’m feeling it. The product itself is very nice. It feels very nice on the skin. I have been using it for about a week now, and feel like it makes my skin glow.

product_name: The Rice Polish Foaming Enzyme Powder
review_text: Received the smaller size that retails for $15 as a deluxe sample with one of my seohora orders. I’m in love with it. I wash my face first with a regular cleanser, then use this. It leaves my skin baby soft, my pores are definitely tighter, and my skin is definitely clearer. I’ve used it about ten times so far and still have more left so a little bit goes a long way. No smell and the packaging is beautiful.
Been using this as my winter moisturizer for years now - super rich and hydrating!

This feels absolutely amazing on my skin! I have been loving to put it in the fridge for a cold de puffing treatment in the morning and very soothing at night! I will continue using this for sure! This was a gifted product :)

This product made my skin feel slightly moisturized. For the price I would not purchase myself. When first applied it made my skin burn but after wiping off with a towel when 10 minutes passed I didn’t see any negative affects from this to my face. I trialed this a few times and the time I put a thicker layer on I got better results!!

product_name: Ultra Glow Serum: Glow + Strengthen Vitamin C Serum
review_text: I absolutely love this vitamin C glow serum, they work great making my skin look so soft and radiant and they smell Great!!
I have never used anything on my face that was so simple and worked so well. Try it, you won’t believe it!

product_name: Mini Deep Cleanse Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser
review_text: It was an ok product. Very mild exfoliation and my skin did not feel any more different after. I will continue to use it until gone since i paid a steep price for this product.

product_name: Argan Infinity Cream Intensive Creamy Oil
review_text: This product works slightly better than the original oil on my super dry, sensitive skin.  After a week of slathering it on my face before bed and spot treating on the morning, I’m still experiencing lots of flaky, red patches.  It smells nice and a little goes a long way.  ¯\_(ツ)_/¯

I gave them both a shot I love coconut and the caramel was good but I’m all for the coconut one it’s amazing! I would really love to repurchase this after I’m out and don’t want this one to leave! Also very interested in the other flavors these are a dream on my lips I haven’t had a product this bomb I just wanna wear it forever not any complaints this is a perfect match for me and I don’t think I can ever part with this product. Worth the money 100 %

I have tried Clinique’s eye and lip treatments and was happy with the results, so decided to take a swing at their cleansing line. let me first say that my face is combination to oily and quite sensitive. I was recommended a line of products “tailored“ to my skin (thought I think she ignored my plight for a sensitive wash and went straight for the problem areas). The “clarifying lotion“ that she assigned was extremely drying and irritating, leaving me with a burning sensation whenever i used it. The oil free lotion I was given with it made my skin itch and it clogged my pores. I was so disappointed with the outcome of these products considering I bought all three...I honestly would have compared it’s effectiveness and benefits to that of a drugstore off-brand. Sorry, Clinique- you’re working with too many chemicals

before I purchased the full size of this product, I was happy to be able to get a decent size for a small price.Now I know that this is a product I would purchase in full size. It is easy to use, and well worth the price
This product is alright. I stopped using it because it contains a fragrance that stings my skin. I wish they make a fragrance free version.

This magical solution makes my skin the smoothest it has ever been in 10 minutes. I have had professional glycolic peels and this gives me superior results without the irritation. I have always had congested and blemish prone skin, but this makes blackheads disappear.  In addition to smoothing everything, it clears the way for other topical products to absorb better. And as a definite bonus, it is under $10!

product_name: Squalane + Vitamin C Rose Firming Oil
review_text: My cheeks get very dry so I decided to get the mini version with insider points. I used on my dry areas after applying moisturizer and it left my skin feeling very hydrated and dewy looking; however, I also noticed more acne on my cheeks after a couple of days of use. Even after discontinuation of the product, the acne continued to come and go, so it is hard to tell if it is related to the oil. I would definitely recommend to anyone with dry to combination skin!

At 1st I really liked this product because I did not have a reaction to it initially, which is unusual for acne treatments. I have very dry, sensitive skin. I got a sample of this because my sensitive skin broke out from trying a new makeup and I wanted to clear it up. Big mistake. I woke up and both my eyes were all puffy and my skin was very dry (especially around the eye area). It seemed to burn the skin around my eyes. Needless to say I will not be purchasing any Murad products.

product_name: Alpha Beta Universal Daily Peel Pads
review_text: I ordered these during the VIB Holiday Sale after having several girlfriends tell me they were great. I used them for 6 days/ treatments & as of last night the right side of my face is completely broken out with tiny red bumps all over my forehead, cheeks and chin. I have never been prone to breakouts other than the occasional pimple here and there. These tiny red bumps are under the skin and look awful. I am going to return them and hope to god that my skin returns to its normal state shortly.

product_name: Rose & Hyaluronic Acid Deep Hydration Toner
review_text: I live for how this toner makes my skin feel, but I feel it may be causing me to break out :(

product_name: The Serum Stick: Treatment & Touch Up Balm
review_text: I received this product from influenster to give an honest review. I’ve been using the product for a few weeks now and do notice a difference in my skin. The balm really does melt into your skin as it says in the description, and leaves my skin hydrated and glowing, but not in an oily way. The solid form allows you to put it on effortlessly, without getting products all over your hands. It’s super convenient for travel, as you don’t have to worry about it spilling in your bag or if it can go through security. My skin gets super dry on planes and I like that I can put this on without touching my face. The only downside in my opinion is that you have less control over how much product you use. I guess you could angle it to just you the corner of the stick if you wanted to get a small area, but in general the product goes very quickly. I like this product for travel and would definitely buy it when mine runs out. However, I prefer nonsolid moisturizers for everyday use because you have more control over how much you use.

product_name: T.L.C. Sukari Babyfacial AHA + BHA Mask
review_text: I really wanted to love this product, because I really like most products from this line, but it was just too harsh for my sensitive skin. My skin is oily and has a lot of redness. I tried this once a month for several months, and every time, it would cause me to break out and my skin would be irritated for days afterwards. Just not for me I guess.

product_name: Mini Barrier+ Triple Lipid-Peptide Face Cream
review_text: I love the product but the refill sucks and does not work. it’s a cool concept but it comes with NO instructions and is extremely dysfunctional. sadly will just have to keep rebuying the pump.

The name says it all. I like the product but it’s not my style of cleanser. I prefer a more clear,  more fresh feel to the face wash I use.  I can see how someone might really like it I received this product as a free sample.“
This is the only sunscreen I’ve ever looked forward to putting on my face. The velvety soft feel of it is wonderful.

product_name: The Camellia Oil 2-in-1 Makeup Remover & Cleanser
review_text: I think the product is great for a makeup removal but there are more affordable solutions. I wouldn’t recommend it or promote it as something that will help your acne either. I’m always on a quest for perfect skin and became fascinated with the Korean skincare routine and started implementing those methods in my routine. I spent a year doing the double cleaning method and now I am starting to realize how unnecessary it is. Don’t get me wrong, the product works, but there are cheaper alternatives for removing your makeup and cleaning your skin. I’m glad I tried this product but I don’t believe the price reflects the value of the product. I typically stick to higher end products but I don’t think a cleansing oil is necessary in a skincare routine.
Works but smells like lemony Kitchen cleaner. Would not re-purchase, even though it does work as a good first cleanse. Didn’t irritate my skin.

product_name: Squalane + Vitamin C Rose Firming Oil
review_text: I was so excited to get this, it was praised by the Strategist, has great reviews, and all around looks awesome. Most of the negative comments I could shrug my shoulders to because of complaints about breakouts (doesn’t every product have some reviews like this??). But the three times that I have tried this — separated by a couple weeks each — my cheeks always became my flushed. I use all kinds of products on my face and do not consider myself to have sensitive skin, so the visible reaction my skin had to this was startling. No horror story here, it was just obvious that my skin disliked it. That’s just me, though. I am sure many people use this and have positive results. So I would only caution against spending over $70 for this when you don’t know how your skin will like it or not.

I remember using this product years ago when in college--and finishing the jar. At Sephora i purchased it on an impulse. But, i returned it. Didn’t “wow“ me... guess that’s why i hadn’t re-purchased it to begin with! I like products that give instant satisfaction/results--this wasn’t one of them, for me at least.

product_name: U.F.O. Salicylic Acid BHA Acne Treatment Face Oil
review_text: So I finally took a chance and decided to test out this product.  After reading other reviews i was nervous to see how my super picky skin reacted. Well, I can say i definitely purged.  For 2 ish weeks my skin broke out more than it ever has and it made me so nervous.  I couldn’t tell if I was reacting bad, or if it was purging and I was so close to stop using this product.  After two weeks I all of a sudden noticed a difference in my skin and it started clearing up. It has been about three weeks now and my skin is just about the clearest it has ever been.  I highly recommend using this last in your routine bc it is a facial oil. Unlike serums it works better after you moisturize! Don’t give up on it and wait it out to see if it clears up bc once it starts clearing up it is totally worth it!

product_name: Vitamin Enriched Face Base Priming Moisturizer
review_text: There is a reason Jeffree Star is always bragging about this, so I went and got it. Pricey, heck yes. But I will say this is a must have. My skin feels so hydrated and for some reason my makeup even loves it. and a little goes a looooonng way. You do not need to plaster your face with this. I put a little dollop on my neck as well. I will say I was  very hesitant of this. but a week in and my skin is very happy.
This cleanser feels very gentle on the skin. I really like it. I received it in my trendmood box
I usually love niacinamide. This percentage, however, was too strong for me and caused a little bit of irritation. I think I’ll stay with 5% and mixing it with moisturizer

This I first got as a sample and used it once didn’t care for it much at first ( so dumb lol ) but then with how horrible this winter weather has been my face got so dry that not only did my makeup look extra patchy and disgusting but even when I would wash my face my skin felt like it was on fire and I just had so much inflammation and redness going on! So I remembered about this stuff because nothing else was helping me so I got a jar and literally not even kidding you the first night I put it on my face the next morning I woke up and it was like 70% better!! Just over 1 night! How amazing! I’m just super happy to have my face looking normal again haha.

I feel this is a hit or miss. Formulation is great, and I was in love with my first bottle. Great at removing dark spots, but second bottle was rancid out of the box. I got a second one as my first had understandably gotten rancid after a year (I use vitamin c with moderation), and the new one smelled the same. Double checked the tester in store. Very different and more pleasant smell. If you get it make sure to check if rancid before using. It’s something I read happened to a lot of other people with this brand.

This stuff is amazing!!!! I was super scared to use oil on my face since I tend to breakout and I am so glad I tried this! review_text: I heard so much about Sunday Riley product I decided to give the dueo a try.
